PSU dividend record dates this week: CONCOR, ONGC, NBCC, RITES, HUDCO, NLC- Check amount, record date, payment timeline
Investors tracking PSU dividends should note record dates of November 11 for CONCOR, HUDCO, NBCC (India) and RITES, and November 12 for ONGC and NLC India. Declared payouts range from ₹0.25 to ₹8 per share.

PSU dividend record dates this week: Container Corporation of India (CONCOR), Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC), RITES, RITES and NLC India are among key public sector undertakings (PSUs) with their dividend record dates scheduled in next few days.
At least six PSUs are set to cut off the eligibility period for dividend in the coming week, i.e. between November 9 and November 13. Here are all the details about upcoming PSU dividend record dates.
PSU dividend record dates this week
CONCOR, Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC), NBCC, RITES, HUDCO, NLC- India, NBCC (India) are the seven firms mentioned in the list.

CONCOR dividend record date
CONCOR share price closed marginally lower at ₹439.10 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of ₹33,442.64 crore on Friday, November 6. The PSU has announced ₹1.9 per equity share dividend for financial year 2026-27 and fixed November 11 as the record date. The second interim dividend will be paid or dispatched to the shareholders on or after November 20, 2026. The payment will be made within 30 days of its declaration.
ONGC dividend record date
ONGC share price closed 0.83% higher at ₹232 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of ₹2,91,862.48 crore on Friday. It has announced ₹8 per equity share dividend with a face value of ₹5 each. The record date for ONGC dividend is Thursday, November 12. Dividend would be paid within 30 days from the date of declaration.
HUDCO dividend
HUDCO has announced ₹1.35 per equity share dividend and has fixed November 11 as the record date. The PSU stock closed 1.20% higher at ₹159.95 per share on BSE with an Mcap of ₹32,020.39 crore on Friday.
NBCC India dividend
Shares of NBCC (India) closed 2.86% lower at ₹78.10 per share on BSE with an Mcap of ₹21,087.00 crore on Friday. The company has announced ₹0.25 per share dividend with a face value of Re 1 each. The board has fixed November 11 as the record date.
RITES dividend
The company has announced ₹1.90 per share dividend with a face value of ₹10 each. The board has fixed November 11 as the record date. RITES share price closed 0.99% lower at ₹194.50 per share on BSE with an Mcap of ₹9,347.74 crore on Friday. Interim dividend shall be paid on or before 03rd December, 2026.
NLC India
Shares of NLC India closed 1.55% at ₹237.55 per share on BSE with an Mcap of ₹32,967.29 crore on Friday. The PSU has announced announced ₹1.50 per share dividend with November 12 fixed as record date. The payment will be made as per the statutory timelines in one or more tranches, as per its BSE filing.
